title: governance.review_due_soon.v1
description: Integration-contract v1 for the review warning (EDR-REMEDIATION-01 D2). A decision's review-by date is near; emitted once per Position version. It is a FACT, not a state change: the Position is untouched, and when the date passes the Finding is re-surfaced exactly as before (governance.disposition_stale.v1).

Owner.description: The accountable owner named on the acceptance; empty when none was named (not_affected, or an older acceptance).
